content: नादः [नद्-घञ्] .²1 A loud roar, cry, shout, sounding, roaring; सिंहनादः, घन˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A sound in general; <ls>Māl. 5. 20</ls>; न नादेन विना गीतं न नादेन विना स्वरः . न नादेन विना रागस्तस्मान्नादात्मकं जगत् .. <ls>Saṅgītadāmodara.</ls> .²3 (In Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>) The nasal sound represented by a semicircle. .²4 One who praises.
